text_block_list.text:
The day of Нарита Таисин's debut is here
at last!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She seems rather restless while she waits
for the
race to begin...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I'm able to ease her nerves with
some
passionate words of
encouragement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
